in_sanskrit.name: Ayog
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Invincible
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Ayog एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Ayog is a Sanskrit name derived from the word ‘ayu’ meaning life and ‘g’ meaning protector or invincible. The name is associated with gods who protect life and grant longevity.

in_marathi.name: Ayog
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ayog हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ayog is a Sanskrit name derived from the word ‘ayu’ meaning life and ‘g’ meaning protector or invincible. The name is associated with gods who protect life and grant longevity.
